_source: Sampled 2026-11-09 by alpha-code#1668 (L6) from a real OpenCode 2 engine: this worktree's packages/cli `serve` at merge target 33f94fce96 (integration branch 5cc6b9273d), isolated HOME/XDG, one git project, and a scratch OpenAI-compatible mock model (`providers.mock`, package @ai-sdk/openai-compatible) that streams reasoning + text + one tool call per scenario. Each record = one /api/event frame plus the session's `GET /api/session/:id/message?order=desc&limit=20` taken right after that frame (what the adapter's projector reads at that moment). `final` = `GET /api/session/:id/message?order=asc&limit=200` after the run went idle.
